Ride Pleasant Streets

Cincinnati, OH · Pleasant Ridge · Social

Beginner friendly

Ride Pleasant Streets is a social group ride in Cincinnati, OH. It rolls first Saturday and Third Saturday of the month at 2:05 pm from Community Happens Here. About <15 (1st Sat) / 15–25 (3rd Sat) miles, welcoming, group-etiquette focused.

About the Ride Pleasant Streets group ride

Neighborhood rides out of Pleasant Ridge with a safety talk first. First Saturdays are short, third Saturdays longer. Routes favor low-stress streets and paths and are shared a few days ahead.
